item.title: At a dental visit
item.description: Practise booking a dental visit and talking about your teeth. Learn terms you may hear during a check-up.

children.definition: A place where people go to have their teeth checked or fixed.
children.example: I called the dental clinic to ask if they had any appointments available on Friday.

children.definition: To move a planned visit or event to a different day or time.
children.example: I need to reschedule my dental visit because I’m working on Tuesday.
children.translation_ru: перенести на другой день или на другое время

children.definition: A place at a clinic where people sit until someone calls them in.
children.example: The receptionist asked me to take a seat in the waiting room.

children.definition: A person whose job is to check and fix people’s teeth.
children.example: My dentist asked if anything had changed since my last visit.

children.definition: A visit to see if your teeth and the soft parts around them are healthy.
children.example: I asked for a check-up before I go away next month.

children.definition: A piece of paper or cloth that keeps your clothes clean and dry during a dental visit.
children.example: The dental assistant clipped a bib around my neck.
children.translation_uz: kiyimni himoya qilish uchun stomatolog qabulida boʻyinga taqiladigan salfetka

children.definition: A small mirror on a handle that a dentist uses to see parts of the mouth that are hard to see directly.
children.example: The dentist used a dental mirror to look behind my top teeth.

children.definition: The soft tissue that surrounds the teeth where they meet the upper and lower jaw.
children.example: During my visit, I told the dentist that my gums sometimes bleed when I brush.

children.definition: One of the two bones that hold your teeth. The lower one moves when you open your mouth.
children.example: The dentist asked me to relax my jaw during the exam.

children.definition: A picture made using X-rays that can show details of your teeth and the bone around them.
children.example: The dentist showed me an x-ray of my back teeth on the screen.

children.definition: A hole in a tooth caused by tooth decay.
children.example: The dentist showed me where the small cavity was in my back tooth.

children.definition: A repair that a dentist makes by putting material into a hole in a tooth.
children.example: The dentist looked at an old filling in one of my back teeth.

children.definition: Thin thread used to clean the spaces between teeth.
children.example: The dentist gave me a small pack of floss at the end of my visit.

children.definition: To wash the inside of your mouth by moving water or another liquid around in it and then spitting it out.
children.example: The dental assistant gave me a cup of water so I could rinse.
